title: Secrets scanning: framework mapping
frameworks: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, Security and Privacy Controls
PCI DSS v4.0.1, PCI Security Standards Council
FedRAMP, based on NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5

SS-01: Commits, pull requests and repository history are scanned for secrets before and after merge.
Scanner configuration and a sample blocked commit
SS-02: Secrets live in a vault or secrets manager and are never hard coded in code, scripts or configuration.
Vault inventory and a clean scan of the main branch
SS-03: Keys and secrets have owners, rotation periods and documented key management procedures.
Key management procedure and rotation records
SS-04: Secret exposure alerts and secret use are monitored and reviewed.
Alert queue, review records and log review evidence
SS-05: Leaked secrets are revoked, rotated and investigated, with notification where personal data is affected.
Incident ticket with revocation and rotation timestamps
SS-06: Access to source code and pipelines is restricted and pipeline configuration is controlled.
Repository permissions and pipeline configuration review
